findings.title: Administrative roles lack phishing-resistant MFA
findings.description: Approved validation showed that selected administrative roles could use a weaker authentication factor.
evidence: Test account admin-review-01 completed the approved sign-in flow with a legacy factor.
findings.remediation: Require phishing-resistant MFA for privileged roles and verify the policy with a dedicated test account.

findings.title: Privileged role changes need centralized alerting
findings.description: The test role assignment was recorded, but no centralized alert reached the assessment contact during the agreed observation window.
evidence: Approved change CR-TEST-1042 appeared in the tenant audit log.
No matching alert was present in the supplied test-case export.
findings.remediation: Create and validate an alert for privileged role assignment, including actor, target, time, and review owner.
